title: Top Toaster Ovens That Replace the Big Oven (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by cross‑referencing Consumer Reports, Good Housekeeping, CNET, ShouldIt, The Guardian, and Epicurious. Products mentioned by more than one source were ranked higher.
assumptions: Prices are not provided because none of the sources list them.

verdict.pick: Breville Joule Smart Oven Air Fryer Pro
verdict.line: Picture a busy kitchen where you need to bake, roast, and air‑fry in one appliance. The Breville Joule delivers fast, even cooking with a large capacity and precise temperature control, making it ideal for families who want a single device for all meals. Its main catch is that it is the most expensive option in this guide.
